business_scope.primary_industry_name: Die-Struck Brass Cloisonné Polishing of Novelty Enamel Badges

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Sultanate of Oman (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax differentiation; commercial licensing administered at Muscat Governorate for the SPC's proposed registered office)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: Civil-law statutory framework with Islamic Sharia as a fundamental source of legislation
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force 1 January 2009; contains investor protections and market-access commitments)
UK-Oman Bilateral Investment Treaty for the Promotion and Protection of Investments
Oman-China Agreement for the Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Commercial Companies Law (Sultani Decree No. 18/2019), including the Single Person Company provisions and the beneficial-owner register obligations as implemented by MOCIIP Ministerial Decision No. 112/2020 (Executive Regulations); Foreign Capital Investment Law (Sultani Decree No. 50/2019); Law on Combating Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (Royal Decree No. 30/2016); subsequent AML/CFT unified instructions issued by the National Centre for Financial Information / Oman Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation or equivalent good-standing certificate of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry / Registrar of Companies in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Origin notary public (if required) → origin Chamber of Commerce (for corporate documents) → origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation → legalization by the Omani Embassy or Consulate. Hague Apostille route is not recognized because Oman is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the local SPC formation agent and/or resident manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin and, where necessary, the competent certifying authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Origin notarization → origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation → Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization; apostille not accepted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incumbency or register of directors and UBOs of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registered agent / companies registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Origin notarization or certifying authority → origin Chamber of Commerce/Registry attestation → origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation → Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of address for each shareholder, director, proposed manager, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or recognized apostille-eligible authority in the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Origin notarization → origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation → Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization; international apostille is not applicable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration for the initial capitalization of the SPC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank where the shareholder maintains the relevant account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank notarization or bank officer signature certification → origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation → Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization where the document is used as part of the AML/CFT CDD file.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the local consolidated terrorism and terrorist-financing list published by the Oman FIU under Royal Decree No. 30/2016, and U.S. OFAC SDN/EPD lists where a U.S. dollar or U.S. nexus exists via Etsy Direct Pay/Stripe. PEPs and their family members/close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth/source-of-funds scrutiny, senior-management approval, and ongoing monitoring. Any positive sanctions hit, adverse media hit, or unexplained PEP escalation requires suspension of the incorporation process and a suspicious transaction report filing before any MOCIIP filing is accepted.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) - Invest Easy e-portal, Trade Name Clearance and Commercial Registration Module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Commercial register certificates are issued in Arabic. The trade name must be in Arabic or transliterated into Arabic using the standard Arabic phonological equivalent. A Latin-script operating name may be used on invoices and packaging only after the Arabic name is registered. Mixed Arabic/foreign characters in a single registered name token are not accepted. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing name in the national commercial register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If MOCIIP rejects a name, the applicant receives a written refusal reason through Invest Easy. Within 30 days of the refusal, the applicant may submit an administrative appeal to the competent Commercial Registration Directorate / Commercial Registration Committee at MOCIIP, attaching the Invest Easy name-search report, evidence that any sensitive token has been approved by the relevant sector regulator, and the corrected Arabic transliteration. The committee normally issues a decision within 15 business days. If the appeal is denied or remains unanswered, the applicant may challenge the decision before the Administrative Court at the Court of First Instance within 60 days of notification. Rejection does not refund the original search fee. Name reservations are not automatically renewable; a new reservation may be filed if the prior reservation has expired without final refusal records.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or PO Box-only address is not permissible for the SPC. The Commercial Companies Law requires a fixed physical place of business in Oman where official notices, books, and records can be reached. For the ISIC 3240 enamel-pin business, a serviced office with physical reception, an Oman street address, a lease agreement, and municipal commercial-use permission is acceptable for administration and third-party warehousing. If any in-country die-struck manufacturing, enameling, or polishing takes place, the registered address must be an industrially-zoned physical premises complying with Muscat Municipality health, safety, and environmental requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate unannounced inspection risk. Estimated 20% probability of a MOCIIP commercial-control inspection within the first operating year for a low-risk distribution-focused SPC. The likelihood increases to approximately 35% if the registered address is a high-density serviced-office cluster or if customs/Municipal data disclose mismatches with the registered activity. In-country production of enamel lapel pins raises the estimated inspection probability to 45% due to labor, municipal licensing, and environmental compliance oversight.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman, Sultani Decree No. 18/2019, as amended by Sultani Decree No. 79/2023; Title II (Incorporation and Company Structures), Chapters on Limited Liability Companies and Single Person Company, read with the Implementing Regulation (Ministerial Decision No. 115/2020).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registration Department, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), operating via the Invest Easy single-window e-portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - SPC Incorporation Application submitted through Invest Easy, together with the executed and notarized Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA) and the Capital Deposit Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital is prescribed for a Single Person Company under Sultani Decree No. 18/2019 as amended; the shareholder must declare capital adequate for the ISIC 3240 objects and deposit 100% of the issued capital in a temporary SPC account at a licensed Omani bank. The bank issues a Capital Deposit (blocking) Certificate to MoCIIP; funds are released only after issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation. Market benchmark for a foreign-owned SPC is OMR 5,000 to 25,000 (approximately USD 13,000 to 65,000).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) the sole Founder subscribes to 100% of the issued share capital of the Single Person Company, fully paid in cash and evidenced by the Capital Deposit Certificate; (2) the Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted, and the Registered Office is fixed in Muscat, Sultanate of Oman; (3) [Name] is appointed General Manager, authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and act before the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion and the Tax Authority; and (4) all incorporation expenses are ratified and ordered paid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Companies Registration Department via Invest Easy portal (www.investeasy.gov.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the Invest Easy external user profile; file the Name Reservation service with the proposed Arabic and English trade names followed by the legal form single person company; declare the activity as manufacture of die-struck brass badges, enamel pins, and novelty metal merchandise (ISIC 3240); pay the nominal reservation fee; the system verifies against the Commercial Registry and blocks names contrary to public order or identical to registered marks.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Signed Know-Your-Customer declaration
Three proposed trade names (Arabic and Latin transliteration)
Power of attorney if filed through a licensed Omani agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, submit an amended name with a distinctive geographic or brand designator and resubmit via the same portal; a formal objection may be filed with the MoCIIP Registry Committee within 15 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution, notarization, and legalization of constitutive documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Omani Notary Public; Consulate of the Sultanate of Oman abroad or Ministry of Foreign Affairs Authentication Section for foreign-executed documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the bilingual Arabic/English MOA and AOA in the MoCIIP model text; have the sole shareholder execute the MOA/AOA and share subscription statement before the notary, with two witnesses; for signatures taken outside Oman, complete consular legalization or apostille and procure a sworn Arabic translation of the signature pages.
required_dossiers: Valid passport and civil ID of the shareholder
Draft MOA and AOA in Arabic
Notarized power of attorney, if applicable
Sworn Arabic translation of the shareholder's corporate resolution if the shareholder is a legal entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar rejects the executed signatures, re-attest the signature pages before the Omani notary and re-upload; no additional state fee is charged if the correction is completed within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of temporary SPC capital account and issuance of deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Omani commercial bank (e.g., Bank Muscat or equivalent licensed branch) - Temporary Company Account Unit.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a company-under-formation current account in the exact approved trade name; deposit the full subscribed share capital in Omani Rials; instruct the bank to issue a Capital Deposit/Blocking Certificate addressed to MoCIIP; the funds remain blocked until presentation of the Certificate of Incorporation, after which they are released to the SPC's order.
required_dossiers: Passport of the shareholder
Name reservation certificate
Draft MOA and AOA
Proof of address and lease intent letter
Source of wealth declaration under AML rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank compliance unit declines the account, escalate to the bank's central compliance team with enhanced KYC or apply to a second licensed bank; the Capital Deposit Certificate remains valid for 90 days and may be renewed once.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation application and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Companies Registration Department via Invest Easy portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete SPC application through Invest Easy by attaching the notarized MOA/AOA, name reservation certificate, and Capital Deposit Certificate; complete the e-declaration of the ISIC 3240 activity; pay the approved government fee electronically; upon approval, download the electronic Certificate of Incorporation and the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate and retain the company e-services credentials.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized MOA and AOA
Name reservation certificate
Capital Deposit Certificate from the bank
Registered office consent or short lease agreement
Passport copies of the shareholder and the appointed General Manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any request for clarification within 10 business days through the portal; amend and resubmit the deficient document; a formal rejection may be appealed by written request to the Registrar for reconsideration within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, municipal business licensing, and post-formation activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (tax.gov.om); the respective Governorate Municipality (e.g., Muscat Municipality); Public Authority for Social Insurance for future hires.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register on the Tax Authority e-portal using the CR number and MOA/AOA to obtain the Tax Registration Number (TRN); apply through the municipal one-stop shop for the Business License covering the registered address with activity code for badge and pin manufacturing; receive the premises use permit; use the CR, TRN, and municipal license to convert the temporary bank account into a permanent corporate account; thereafter configure Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe merchant onboarding under the SPC legal name.
required_dossiers: Electronic Copy of the Certificate of Incorporation and CR
MOA and AOA as registered
Municipal Business License application
Lease contract or title deed in the SPC name
Civil Defense preliminary fire safety clearance
Appointment letter of the General Manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality refuses the business license on zoning grounds, request an activity-compatible use opinion from the Investor Services window or relocate to the licensed industrial area and re-file; the tax registration can proceed independently of the municipal decision.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no statutory industrial operating license is required for ISIC 3240 badge and enamel pin production under the Omani Commercial Registration regime; if a dedicated factory premises is later registered, the competent optional window is the Industrial Development Department of MoCIIP for a Light Industrial Establishment registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable; the operative permits are the municipal Business License with activity code 3240, the PACDA premises clearance, and the Environment Authority registration certificate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority (EA) of the Sultanate of Oman, established under Royal Decree No. 114/2001.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Environmental Registration; no full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is required for a small-scale die-struck badge, hard enamel, and novelty pin workshop with annual metal throughput below 25 tonnes; an online Environmental Compliance Registration Statement must be filed and the registration certificate exhibited at the premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero discharge of industrial effluent to public drains unless a trade effluent permit is granted; where treated and permitted, pH must be 6.5-8.5, chemical oxygen demand below 100 mg/l, total suspended solids below 20 mg/l, and nickel and copper each below 0.5 mg/l; solvent-borne enamel and lacquer VOC content limited to 200 g/l or less; hazardous wastes (electroplating sludge, spent acids, alkaline cleaners) must be stored in sealed drums and transported only by an EA-licensed waste carrier under an electronic waste manifest; airborne particulates and fumes must comply with the ambient and emission limits of Ministerial Decrees No. 287/2001 and No. 80/2018.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety and Civil Defense Certificate from the Public Authority for Civil Defence and Ambulance (PACDA) based on approved fire extinguisher layout, emergency exits, and electrical safety; structural load inspection certificate issued by a licensed Omani engineer for the workshop floor and mezzanine; workplace health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Labour including local exhaust ventilation for enamel fume, noise assessment, material safety data sheets for etching and plating chemicals, and a safe operating certificate for all polishing and enamelling stations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) — the national tax regulator established under Royal Decree No. 75/2020, successor to the Ministry of Finance's tax functions. It administers the Income Tax Law (RD 28/2009), VAT Law (RD 121/2016), and Excise Tax Law (RD 23/2017) through the Taxoman E-Services portal (https://taxoman.gov.om).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned SPC: (1) incorporate via MoCIIP/InvestEasy to obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) number; (2) open the OTA taxpayer profile on Taxoman and apply for the Tax Identification Number (TIN) using the CR certificate, constitutional documents, and shareholder identification; (3) complete VAT registration in the same profile once taxable supplies reach OMR 38,500 (mandatory) or OMR 19,250 (voluntary) over the rolling 12 months; (4) obtain the Bayan/GCC customs exporter ID for export declarations; (5) keep the profile updated annually with beneficial ownership and business activity details.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman has no check-the-box or hybrid classification election; the SPC is taxed at entity level. Available elections: (i) voluntary VAT registration at the OMR 19,250 threshold; (ii) OTA-approved fiscal year election; (iii) indefinite loss carry-forward subject to 50% ownership/substance continuity; (iv) group VAT registration election for affiliated persons. Hybrid mismatch double-deduction outcomes are not recognized.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) — Royal Decree No. 121/2016
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 annual taxable supplies (mandatory registration); OMR 19,250 annual taxable supplies (voluntary registration).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman has not yet enforced a mandatory real-time fiscal clearance stamp; compliance operates through periodic VAT returns and OTA e-services. The OTA National E-Invoicing Roadmap, however, is phasing in mandatory XML/UBL e-invoicing, API-based clearance, and digital stamping via Taxoman; exporters must be ready to issue invoices through OTA-compliant tools and retain machine-readable datasets for audit matching against Bayan customs and bank records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of enamel novelty pins from Oman to non-GCC destinations are zero-rated when title passes to a non-resident customer, goods are physically removed from Oman within the evidenced period, and the supplier is VAT-registered. Direct export services are also zero-rated; input VAT on raw materials is refundable/offsettable once export evidence is complete.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan / GCC unified export certificate)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR evidencing physical export from Oman
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) from an Omani licensed bank
Commercial invoice and original customer purchase order
0% VAT export invoice and packing list
Certificate of origin, where preferential treatment is claimed
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: OTA may audit export zero-rating claims for five years from the filing/assessment window (longer in fraud cases). Failure to evidence movement, ownership, or repatriated proceeds reverses the 0% rate to 5% VAT, with assessment of unpaid tax, late penalties, and statutory violation fines. Fabricated customs documents or IRCs constitute tax evasion, triggering criminal prosecution, clawback of erroneous VAT refunds, and suspension from the refund scheme.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully freely convertible for both current and capital account transactions. There are no exchange controls preventing foreign equity contribution, profit repatriation, or dividend remittance; however, banks require underlying commercial/investment documentation and tax clearance for large capital transfers. The OMR is officially pegged to the US Dollar at OMR 1 = USD 2.6008, providing exceptional exchange-rate stability.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no mandatory conversion or surrender requirement on export proceeds. Exporters may retain all foreign currency in authorised bank accounts, and there is no statutory timeline for conversion into OMR. Nevertheless, export receipts must be reconciled through licensed Omani banks to support export documentation, customs clearance, and corporate tax obligations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low. The Central Bank of Oman does not maintain an electronic money institution (EMI) licensing framework. Third-country digital EMIs cannot open regulated accounts in Oman. They may only serve as PSPs (payment service providers) layered over a licensed Omani bank account. The mandatory clearing and settlement account must rest with a physical Omani commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most Omani commercial banks require at least one director or authorised signatory to present in-person for the initial corporate KYC interview. Remote opening is generally not permitted for non-resident single-person companies. Virtual meetings may be used as a supplement, but they do not replace the physical presence mandate under standard CBO-compliant procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident 100% foreign ownership with a single shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport copy, Commercial Registration (CR) certificate, Articles of Association (AoA), board resolution authorising account opening, beneficial ownership schedule, and a bank reference from the shareholder's home-country bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border marketplace flows from Etsy and Stripe to an Oman entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Marketplace payout statements, order volume and value logs, export e-invoices, courier airway bills, Incoterms-based sales contracts, platform PCI-DSS attestation, and a written explanation of the SaaS platforms' settlement mechanics.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Structurally low-ticket consumer enamel pin payments creating high volume but low average units
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Product catalogue and pricing sheet for die-struck cloisonné pins, Shopify/Etsy API export showing order patterns, refund/chargeback ratio, production unit cost model, and sourcing documents for brass and enamel raw materials.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity for a fully foreign-owned SPC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised certificate of ultimate beneficial owner, valid national ID/passport, proof of economic substance in Oman (warehouse lease or virtual office with dedicated engagement), negative-media compliance report, and screening screenshots from licensed AML database.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injection must be routed via SWIFT MT103 with a clear 'For Further Credit to [Company Name and Account]' instruction in the 86 field. The reference line must state 'SPC Share Capital Injection' together with the company CR number. Purpose-of-payment code should follow IMF BPM6 classification for direct investment equity (direct: equity capital), ensuring the Omani receiving bank can tag the inflow for CBO reporting. The remitter should pre-notify the receiving bank with the company's CR, AoA, and bank account details to prevent anti-money laundering holds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For import of brass blanks, copper cladding, enamel paints, and die machinery, use SWIFT MT103 with commercial invoice encapsulation or a straightforward irrevocable documentary letter of credit (at sight) for large repeat shipments. For B2B export sales additional to marketplace channels, collect via SWIFT MT103 against pro-forma invoice and Incoterms. For Etsy/Stripe settlements, funds are cleared by the processor into the Omani bank via group nostro SWIFT MT103 or instant rail. All outbound disbursement files must include invoice references, harmonized system (HS) codes, and supplier EVO (beneficiary ownership) screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/OMR Currency Forwards (available through Omani licensed banks; pegged-rate stability makes tenors seamless)
FX Swaps (USD/OMR vs OMR/USD with matched maturities)
Cross-currency swaps against USD for funding in GCC currencies
Interest rate hedges on trade-financing lines (not pure FX, but permitted in conjunction with LC/forfaiting)
Offshore OMR/USD NDFs—technically not a CBO-licensed domestic product; only use with foreign bank counterparties outside Omani regulatory perimeter if necessary

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Register Renewal and Trade License Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), Commercial Registration Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based: file within the 60-day window preceding commercial register certificate expiry; exact renewal date is shown on the MoCIIP renewal notice.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: OMR 20-50 per month late-renewal surcharge, trade license suspension after 60 days of expiry, and administrative strike-off in the Commercial Register for continued non-renewal under Sultani Decree 18/2019.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax year; for calendar-year accounts by 30 April of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine of OMR 1,000-5,000, monthly late-payment interest up to 1.5% on outstanding tax, withholding of tax clearance, and referral for enforcement against the SPC's license and bank accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification and Annual Substance Report (applicability confirmation required)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority, Economic Substance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual notification filed within 12 months of the fiscal year-end, with the related economic substance report contemporaneously submitted for relevant activities (calendar-year filers by 31 December).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: OMR 1,000 penalty for default of the notification, OMR 5,000-50,000 for failing the substance test, and escalation to MoCIIP for administrative restrictions on the commercial license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Register Confirmation / Shareholding Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registration and National AML-FIU data feed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual commercial register renewal and within 30 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties of up to OMR 5,000 per violation under the Omani AML Law and SD 18/2019, renewal rejection, and suspension of share registration until UBO records are rectified.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements and Statutory Books Submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (with annual return) and SPC shareholder records at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 4 months of the fiscal year-end when audit is mandatory; adoption and signing by the sole shareholder in the general meeting of the Single Person Company.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unaudited filing is treated as an incomplete tax submission, attracting OMR 1,000-5,000 penalties and mandatory re-filing orders; repeated failure prompts forced audit by the Tax Authority.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent statutory audit is compulsory when annual gross sales exceed OMR 50,000 (approx. USD 130,000) or paid-up capital exceeds OMR 100,000; the SPC may otherwise file unaudited accounts unless license conditions, lenders, or Tax Authority notice require an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Oman for entities above the audit thresholds; simplified local GAAP for micro and small companies below the statutory audit thresholds.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC must maintain its UBO register at the registered office, record any share transfer and controller change within 30 days, and reconfirm the beneficial ownership schedule at each annual commercial renewal; the annual confirmation declares the full chain of shareholding through the ultimate individual owners, and non-updated UBO records block the annual renewal and share registration.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% (unified corporate income tax rate under Royal Decree 28/2009 as amended by Royal Decree 54/2023, applicable to all resident companies; petroleum-sector activities are taxed at 55%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No reduced rate is available to a foreign-owned Single Person Company. Available reliefs: (i) a 5-year income tax holiday for qualifying industrial/manufacturing projects established in Madayn industrial cities or designated free zones, granted by Cabinet decree upon application; (ii) participation exemption for foreign dividends and capital gains on qualifying shareholdings of at least 10% held for 12 months; (iii) 0% VAT on exported enamel-pin goods supplied to non-Omani customers through Etsy/Stripe (indirect tax treatment).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return 'OMR-CIT-01' filed exclusively on the Oman Tax Authority e-Services portal (taxoman.om); pre-filing registration requires the Commercial Registration (CR) number, the Tax Registration Number (TRN), a verified eKey, and an auditor registered with the Tax Authority for companies exceeding the audit threshold.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return must be filed within 6 months of the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SPC the deadline is 30 June of the following year. One extension of up to 2 months may be granted on written application to the Tax Authority before the original deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Registration Number (15-digit), Commercial Registration number, fiscal year covered, legal form code (SPC), address, and contact details of the foreign sole shareholder.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident passive shareholder has no filing obligation in this block; the resident SPC acts as the single taxable entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total worldwide gross turnover of the SPC, including Etsy/Stripe settlement amounts, shipping surcharges, and other commercial income; resident companies are taxed on worldwide income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident with an Oman permanent establishment (PE) must declare only Oman-source revenue attributable to the PE in its separate non-resident return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Capital gains on asset disposals, foreign exchange gains, interest, and foreign-source income; participation-exempt foreign dividends are excluded here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable; a non-resident without a PE declares only Oman-source items in the non-resident form OMR-NR-01.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Automatic summation of Box 1 and Box 2.
Direct production costs of die-struck brass blanks, enamel cloisons, plating, packaging, and freight-in, supported by supplier invoices and inventory records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible only if the non-resident carries on a trade through an Oman PE and maintains Oman books.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, Etsy/Stripe platform fees, PayPal charges, design royalties, rent, utilities, salaries, and professional fees, with statutory disallowances separately added back.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Head-office costs are deductible only to the extent of the OECD-compatible attribution to the Oman PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible items: 50% of entertainment costs, non-business expenses, fines, and related-party payments failing the arm's-length standard.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Same add-back rules apply to an Oman PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Capital allowances on dies, stamping machinery, and equipment computed on the tax schedule of the Oman Income Tax Law; book depreciation is reversed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital allowances are claimable only against PE income and assets effectively connected to the PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit computed as Box 3 minus Box 4, Box 5, and Box 7, plus Box 6 add-backs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Computed within the non-resident return under the same mechanics.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses brought forward from up to 5 prior tax years, verified against audited returns and not exceeding 100% of current-year taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not claimable by a non-resident shareholder against Omani dividends or capital gains.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit after loss set-off; the base subject to the 15% headline rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: PE taxable income before application of treaty limitations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed tax at the statutory rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PE profits taxed at 15%; services/royalty payments from Oman are instead captured by the 10% withholding mechanism.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits under DTAs, withheld tax credits, and any advance tax instalments paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Treaty relief is claimed by separate application, not by self-assessment in this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final liability after credits; payment instruction for the Oman Tax Authority's account or refund request.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Final non-resident liability is settled through the withholding agent unless a PE return is filed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Mandatory transfer-pricing schedule disclosing each related party, country, transaction type, and consideration for all controlled transactions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident related counterparty must provide data to the Oman filer to support the declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of royalties, service fees, and other Oman-source payments to non-residents during the year, with 10% WHT evidenced.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Receipts net of WHT must be supported by Omani Tax Authority certificates before treaty credit is claimed abroad.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed penalty of RO 500 up to RO 2,000 per return, with continued default escalating to administrative enforcement; late payment: 10% per annum surcharge on the unpaid tax; incorrect or understated return: penalty of 25% of the underpaid tax; tax evasion: fine of up to double the tax evaded and imprisonment of up to 3 years. Additional ministerial penalties apply for failure to attach audited financial statements (required when turnover or assets exceed RO 100,000).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Oman imposes no dividend withholding tax under domestic law. Dividends distributed by the resident SPC to a non-resident sole shareholder are exempt from Omani tax and remitted gross, provided the distribution is made from tax-paid, audited retained earnings, evidenced by a shareholder resolution and audited financial statements, and the SPC remains compliant with its annual filing obligations.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because the domestic dividend rate is already 0%, DTA relief is relevant mainly for royalties, interest, and capital gains. The protocol is: (1) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the beneficial owner's tax authority; (2) file a DTA relief application with the Oman Tax Authority attaching the TRC, beneficial-ownership declaration, commercial agreements, and shareholding/ownership chart; (3) receive a written relief or reduced-withholding order before the cross-border payment is executed; (4) renew the documentation annually and retain it for 10 years because the Omani payer acts as agent and remains jointly liable for any unwithheld tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and technical, management, or consultancy service fees paid to non-residents are subject to a 10% domestic withholding tax, reducible to 0–10% under applicable DTAs (depending on the treaty partner and beneficial-ownership test). Interest paid to non-resident banks and financial institutions on arm's length commercial borrowings carries a 0% domestic WHT; interest on shareholder or related-party loans is exposed to re-characterization as a dividend or to transfer-pricing adjustment, which would then attract 15% CIT and, where applicable, 10% withholding on the adjusted amount.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: RO 100,000 aggregate related-party transactions per tax year triggers mandatory contemporaneous Local File documentation and the annual related-party declaration (Schedule A). A Master File is required where the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds RO 25 million. Documentation must be submitted to the Tax Authority within 30 days of a formal request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has not enacted UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations; however, the Income Tax Law contains substance-over-form, general anti-avoidance, and beneficial-ownership provisions authorizing the Tax Authority to disregard artificial entities, re-attribute profits to the foreign shareholder, and deny treaty benefits where the SPC lacks physical premises, employees, an Oman bank account, proper books, and genuine decision-making in Oman. A single-person company operating as a mere sales platform for a foreign principal is the primary audit target.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing Etsy/Stripe settlement receipts to the shareholder's foreign PayPal, Stripe, or personal bank account; not recording cash sales; submitting a nil return while marketplace data shows regular sales; inflating fictitious cost lines to erase taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional tax at 15% on the suppressed profit; 25% penalty on the underpaid tax; criminal fine up to double the tax evaded; imprisonment up to 3 years under Article 70 of the Income Tax Law; automatic late-payment surcharge of 10% per annum.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The shareholder-director is jointly liable with the SPC; the Tax Authority may obtain a travel ban, an asset freeze, and a court order requiring personal restitution where the company is a mere instrumentality.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SPC with no physical office in Oman, no local employees, no Omani bank account, a nominee resident manager, and all production, design, and pricing decisions taken by the foreign shareholder; using the SPC solely to obtain an Omani invoice or a tax residence certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-computation of taxable income on a deemed basis at 15%; denial of treaty benefits; disallowance of management fees paid abroad; deregistration from the Commercial Register under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019) and possible forced dissolution; additional penalties for non-maintenance of books and records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of the corporate veil: the shareholder and any shadow director become personally liable for corporate tax debts; a civil restitution order for the tax avoided and a travel ban pending settlement are standard administrative measures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Under-invoicing export sales of enamel pins to a related US/EU distribution entity so that the Oman SPC earns an operating margin below 2% while the related distributor retains a 20–30% margin; failing to prepare the Local File after exceeding the RO 100,000 threshold; submitting an inconsistent Schedule A declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Upward adjustment of taxable income by the Tax Authority; 15% CIT on the adjusted amount; 25% misstatement penalty; separate monetary penalty for failure to produce TP documentation on request; interest at 10% per annum on the resulting underpayment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who signed the false TP declaration faces personal liability for the additional tax and penalties; in aggravated cases the matter is referred to the public prosecutor with exposure to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying design royalties, licensed-character fees, software fees, or technical service fees to a foreign design studio without deducting the 10% Omani withholding tax; paying gross and then claiming the deduction without a Tax Authority relief order.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The SPC as withholding agent is personally required to remit the uncollected 10% WHT; additional penalties of 25% of the withheld amount; late-payment surcharge of 10% per annum; criminal referral for knowing failure to withhold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the company secretary are severally liable as agents of the Tax Authority; personal seizure of assets and a travel ban may be ordered until the WHT liability is settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving high-volume Etsy/Stripe card settlement proceeds into a personal foreign account; repeated cash withdrawals structured below reporting thresholds in Oman; failure to file the Beneficial Ownership register with the Ministry of Commerce; transacting with sanctioned payment intermediaries or unexplained third-party settlement entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money-laundering penalties under the Oman Anti-Money Laundering Law (Royal Decree 30/2016): imprisonment up to 7 years, fines up to RO 50,000, confiscation of proceeds, and cancellation of the Commercial Registration; administrative fines for late BO registration apply separately.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The sole shareholder and any beneficial-owner nominee face direct criminal liability; conviction triggers personal imprisonment, blocking of all Omani bank accounts, credit restrictions, and a permanent travel ban until the order is served.
